rows.endpoint: Spot user data (WS API userDataStream.subscribe.signature; REST listenKey retired)
rows.note: SpotApiClient/FuturesApiClient/CoinFuturesApiClient exposes schema-checked WS API methods and signed requests; Spot user streams use WS API subscription, not retired REST listenKey.

Cross-margin risk listen-key lifecycle is supported. Trade/account events can use SpotApiClient.subscribe_user_data_listen_token with a caller-provided token. REST POST /sapi/v1/userListenToken is not wrapped: the current official page omits an explicit authentication/signature specification and the official SDK has no matching implementation.

rows.endpoint: Spot WebSocket API order entry (wss://ws-api.binance.com:443/ws-api/v3): order.place, cancel, cancelReplace, amend.keepPriority, orderList.*, sor.*, session.logon, userDataStream.subscribe
rows.note: SpotApiClient/FuturesApiClient/CoinFuturesApiClient exposes schema-checked WS API methods and signed requests; Spot user streams use WS API subscription, not retired REST listenKey. All native schema methods have request/signature wire cases; session.logon is explicitly rejected because the client supports HMAC rather than Ed25519 session authentication.
